name: Senoo Kunpuu Butousai -Menuet-
source:
Main character is a son of a leading conglomerate. He lives a normal college life with two people - his friend and butler. But one day he notices friend going out on his own. And strange rumors start to spread...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是某家大型企业集团的继承人。他和朋友、管家一起过着普通的大学生活。然而有一天，他注意到朋友独自外出，奇怪的传闻也开始流传……

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
